name: WayriCAD QuickTherm
description: Saved-board thermal screening with component field mapping and visual results.
description_full: Read-only steady-state thermal screening using mapped component dissipation and thermal resistance, optional copper-layer and vertical-path models, virtual heatsinks, mounting boundaries, top/bottom/3D previews, cross-selection and local HTML/JSON evidence. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib is required. This is not CFD or coupled electrothermal simulation.
